scenario: 今天的检索赛道在问，证据该以多细的粒度进索引，换编码器或换机构时知识怎么流动，以及智能体的可搜索世界要不要跟着能力一起长。视觉文档和图表页不再适合先抽成纯文本再检索，区域或多向量可以直接对齐页面上真正有用的局部。冷启动换模型和跨机构的联邦检索，则尽量少重新编码、少传递原文。训练搜索 agent 时，任务和证据需要一起沿能力边界生长；视频里选错片子、长视频证据残缺，也说明先找对对象、再保住可检查的时间证据同样关键。搜索能力还可以在预训练里就学会，而不必全部留给后期微调。

papers.title: When Visually Rich Documents Meet Multi-Vector Retrieval for Region-level Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Xu Yuan, Liangbo Ning, Yujuan Ding, Qing Li, Wenqi Fan
papers.abstract: Visually rich documents (VRDs) convey knowledge through textual, visual, and layout information that text-centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Text-RAG) struggles to fully exploit. Recent Vision-RAG approaches enable retrieval and generation directly from document images, retaining this multimodal information. However, earlier Vision-RAG methods commonly adopt coarse retrieval representations and full-page visual contexts, which can obscure local evidence and introduce substantial redundancy and computational overhead. To address these challenges, we propose MV-VisRAG, a region-level Vision-RAG framework that uses semantically complete regions for both document representation and visual augmentation. Specifically, MV-VisRAG first constructs these regions through a ContentAdaptive Regionalization module. It then encodes them into local region vectors and a page-level global vector using a VLM-based retriever trained through multimodal reconstruction pretraining and retrieval fine-tuning. With this compact multi-vector representation, MV-VisRAG performs late-interaction retrieval and estimates region contributions from the resulting matching scores. These contributions guide the selection of relevant regions, which are then rearranged into a compact visual context for generation. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate retrieval and generation gains over corresponding baselines, while region-level augmentation substantially reduces visual tokens and computational cost. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/xandery-geek/MV-VisRAG.
papers.summary: 视觉文档的检索增强生成如果只用整页粗表示，局部证据容易被淹没，生成时整页图像也会带进大量冗余的视觉 token。一套区域级方法先把页面拆成语义完整的区域，再用多向量做延迟交互检索，并根据匹配分数估计各区域贡献，只把相关区域重排成紧凑的视觉上下文。在五套基准上，相对最强的单向量视觉基线 VDocRAG，采用 Phi3V 时平均 nDCG@5 提高 3.47 分；区域增强相对整页把视觉 token 减少 43% 到 62%。==用语义完整的区域同时做匹配和选证据，可以在更少视觉输入里保住检索和生成效果。==表格类数字题仍可能因表头被裁掉而变差。

papers.title: ERA: Embed, Route, Adapt for Cold-Start Cross-Model Latent Retrieval
papers.authors: Venkata Chivukula, Zifeng Wang, Jinsung Yoon
papers.abstract: Production retrieval systems are tied to the embedding model that indexed their corpus. Moving queries to a different encoder normally requires re-embedding the whole corpus, and at cold start there are no query logs while every document embedded by the new encoder incurs an API or compute cost. We present ERA (Embed, Route, Adapt), a system for cold-start cross-model latent retrieval. ERA spends a small anchor budget on maximally informative documents, selected from the existing target index via Cosine Farthest Point Sampling, trains a lightweight adapter with a Manifold Alignment Loss that couples directional alignment with orthogonal regularization to prevent representation collapse, and pairs the adapter with a deterministic router that escalates the rare, hard queries that define perceived retrieval quality. Across five BEIR datasets, ERA matches or outperforms point-wise L2 and embedding-conversion baselines, with relative gains of up to 35% nDCG@10 on Arguana, and on clustered corpora its anchor selection also improves prior methods under a fixed anchor budget. With 1.2 ms of adapter and router overhead on top of a ~20 ms local encoder, ERA at a 20% nominal escalation budget reduces end-to-end query latency from roughly 160 ms to 38-86 ms while concentrating escalations on the queries where the projection fails most.
papers.summary: 生产检索系统一旦换了 query 编码器，通常要把整个语料重新编码一遍；冷启动时既没有 query 日志，每编一条文档又要付出计算或接口成本。Google 的做法是只花一小笔锚点预算，在已有目标索引里按余弦最远点采样挑出最有信息量的文档，训练轻量适配器，再用确定性路由把少数难 query 升级到目标编码器。在五套 BEIR 数据上，它达到或超过逐点 L2 和向量转换基线，Arguana 上 nDCG@10 的相对提升最高达 35%。在两成名义升级预算下，端到端延迟从约 160 毫秒降到 38 至 86 毫秒，升级会集中在投影最容易失败的 query 上。

papers.title: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
papers.authors: Yi Ding, Gaurav Kumar, Rui Min, Isabella Ye, Bhavika Goyal, Emilio Antunez, Huihui Chen, Ke Xu, Xiaowei Sun, Xin Xu, Huijie Feng, Pradyumna Narayana, Golnaz Farhadi
papers.abstract: Sustaining user experience (UX) quality in large-scale web search requires scalable evaluation. Traditional surveys are slow and bottleneck rapid A/B testing, while automated metrics often lack the granularity to diagnose visual-spatial UX anomalies. To address this, we introduce the Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework, a novel industrial architecture for automated UX attribution. Tier 1 (Macro System) acts as a scalable user sentiment regression detector, utilizing a fine-tuned encoder-decoder LLM (based on Gemini XS) on telemetry features. Through multi-task regularization and contextual feature engineering, this tier achieves a +9.8% PR-AUC gain on over 500,000 held-out records, matching baseline recall on all validated regressions with $\sim$20% relative precision gain among the 12 held-out experiments. In production, it reduces measurement latency from weeks to hours and cuts survey overhead by over 40%. Tier 2 (Micro System) provides granular diagnostics by employing a Multimodal LLM (Gemini 3.0 Pro) to natively assess visual renderings and spatial layout of web result blocks, quantifying "User Toil" as the estimated effort required to reach a satisfactory result. Enhanced by RL-based automated prompt optimization and an AI judge for win/loss patterns, the MLLM yields a $>$6.5% F1 score improvement, offering deep insights into content quality and layout friction. Ultimately, this framework enables scalable, accurate, and diagnostic UX attribution, processing O(100k) live experiment queries daily.
papers.summary: 大规模网页搜索要盯住用户体验，传统问卷太慢，会卡住快速 A/B 测试，自动指标又往往看不清版式和空间上的异常。Google 用双层框架做可扩展归因：第一层用基于 Gemini XS 的微调模型读取遥测特征，检测整页满意度是否回退；第二层用多模态模型直接看结果块的渲染和布局，估计用户翻到满意结果要花多少力气。第一层在五十多万条留出记录上把 PR-AUC 提高 9.8%，上线后把测量延迟从数周压到数小时，问卷开销降低超过 40%。==先筛整页回退，再诊断局部摩擦，才能既跟得上实验速度，又说得清问题出在哪。==

papers.title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
papers.authors: Chengchao Lv, Yin Wang, Chunzheng Zhu, Wanli Chang
papers.abstract: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent. These recipes, however, treat the searchable world as fixed: a new question can be well formed and verifiable while its evidence is absent from the retrieval backend, so the agent issues the right query, retrieves nothing, and is penalized as if its policy were at fault. Such unreachable negatives accumulate with every round of growth. We propose Search-RSI, a recursive self improvement framework that expands the search world along the agent's capability frontier. In each round, the current policy diagnoses its partially mastered regions of a task space spanned by hop depth, relation rarity, and distractor density; new tasks there are grown together with their evidence; and the same policy decides how they are used: candidates on which its probes disagree feed reinforcement learning, while those beyond its reach become hint guided demonstrations of its own. Keeping the policy inside this loop matters: an improver frozen at the start of training loses 3.2 points. On nine multimodal search benchmarks, Search-RSI keeps improving where static task growth saturates, raising the average accuracy of the recipe it builds on by 9.8 and 9.5 points at 9B and 27B, of which 7.0 points are out of reach for a world that is merely made consistent. The loop uses no external model and only privileged task structure that is removed before training, at 1.27x the compute of static growth.
papers.summary: 多模态搜索 agent 用不断生长的多跳任务来训练时，常把可搜索世界当成固定的：新问题可以写得对、也能验证，但检索后端里没有对应证据，agent 查对了却什么也拿不到，反而被当成策略出了错。一种递归改进框架让任务和证据一起沿着能力边界生长：当前策略先诊断自己半会不会的区域，再决定新任务是拿去强化学习，还是做成带提示的示范。在九个基准上，它把所继承配方的平均准确率在 9B 和 27B 规模上分别提高 9.8 和 9.5 个百分点，其中 7.0 个点是仅仅把世界补一致所达不到的。==可搜索世界要跟着策略的能力一起长，而不能只往一个固定索引里堆新问题。==

papers.title: DiTraR: Diverse Scorers and Transcript-Guided Re-ranking for Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
papers.authors: Mohammad Alijanpour Shalmani, Alale Rezvani Boroujeni, Ali Amini
papers.abstract: Video corpus moment retrieval asks a system to find, in a large collection of untrimmed videos with subtitles, the video and the time interval that a natural-language query describes. We find that most top-ranked errors of a strong corpus-level scorer come from choosing the wrong video, not from imprecise boundaries, and that re-weighting the evidence the scorer already uses does not fix them. We present DiTraR, which addresses video selection from two complementary directions. A witness-interval scorer decomposes the query into probes and scores every candidate interval of every corpus video exactly; a multi-scorer energy ensemble averages the energies of independently trained scorers before one exhaustive search; and a transcript verifier, a frozen language model that reads the time-stamped dialogue of the highest-ranked videos, re-orders the moments without changing their boundaries. With all settings frozen on development data and a single evaluation, DiTraR reaches 24.36 and 13.55 R@1 at IoU 0.5 and 0.7 on the TVR validation split. The ensemble improves queries about visual content, the verifier improves queries about dialogue, and their gains largely add up.
papers.summary: 在大规模未剪辑视频库里按自然语言查找片段时，一个强的语料级打分器排在最前面的错误，多数是选错了视频，而不是时间边界不够准；把它已经用过的证据再重新加权，也补不好这些错误。一种方法从两边补视频选择：多个独立训练的见证区间打分器先对能量取平均，并穷举搜索每个视频的每个候选区间；再用冻结语言模型阅读排名最高的那些视频的带时间戳对白，只重排片段、不改边界。设定全部在开发集上冻结后，TVR 验证集上交并比达到 0.5 时的 R@1 为 24.36，比单个打分器高 4.13 个百分点。集成主要帮助视觉类 query，对白校验主要帮助对话类 query，两边增益大体可以累加。

papers.title: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
papers.authors: Kaustubh Ponkshe, Gyung Hyun Je, Stefan Taga, Colin Raffel, Martin Jaggi
papers.abstract: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. Yet pretraining remains predominantly focused on predicting static text, with search capabilities typically introduced during post-training. We propose Search-Native Pretraining as a practical route to teach search capability during pretraining from ordinary text corpora. Specifically, we augment pretraining corpus at scale with web-search queries and retrieve web response using a local index. Training on this augmented corpus teaches models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence during language modeling. Across Wikipedia and DCLM-Edu corpora and 360M to 3.3B parameter scales, search-pretrained models ("QueryLM") show improved performance on knowledge-intensive tasks and higher steerability toward the retrieved evidence. Crucially, their advantage persists after supervised fine-tuning of both search-pretrained and conventionally pretrained models, indicating that the tested post-training procedures do not fully recover the capabilities developed during pretraining. Throughout our experiments, we find that a 1.4B QueryLM consistently beats or matches the performance of a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline model across all knowledge intensive tasks. These results establish search-pretraining as a practical way to develop foundational search capabilities during pretraining. We release the training artifacts, including model checkpoints and data.
papers.summary: 现在的语言模型在推理时越来越多会接上搜索工具，但预训练仍主要在预测静态文本，检索能力往往要到后期微调才补上。搜索原生预训练在普通语料里大规模插入网页搜索 query，并用本地索引取回结果，让模型在语言建模的同时学会发起检索、用证据继续写。在 Wikipedia 和 DCLM-Edu 上、从数亿到数十亿参数，这一优势在对检索预训练模型和常规预训练模型都做监督微调之后仍然存在。以八项知识密集型问答的平均成绩计，十四亿参数的检索预训练模型在基座设定下达到 30.3%，超过计算量对齐的三十三亿参数常规模型的 23.9%。

papers.title: EP-LVMQA: Evidence-Preserving Coarse-to-Fine Localization for Low-Quality Long Video Moment Question Answering
papers.authors: Guoning Chen, Zhexun Hu, Yifan Wei, Yixuan Weng, Bin Li, Yufei Zhao
papers.abstract: Long instructional videos are increasingly used in medical education, industrial training, and procedural knowledge transfer, yet their evidence is often incomplete or unreliable: subtitles may be missing, ASR noisy, OCR sparse, and decisive actions briefly shown without narration. Existing VideoQA systems typically return labels or free-form text, making answer support difficult to inspect. We study Long Video Moment Question Answering (LVMQA), where a system returns timestamped answer-supporting evidence. We propose EP-LVMQA, an evidence-preserving coarse-to-fine framework comprising an Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Timeline, a Coarse Evidence Planner, and an Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer. An evidence card transfers planner scores, matched cues, source-confidence proxies, modality-specific evidence, neighboring context, and a temporal prior between the latter two modules. On MedVidQA, EP-LVMQA achieves 26.1 R1@0.5 and 31.8 mIoU, improving the strongest non-ours results by 6.3 and 5.1 points. It raises Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 to 25.4 and 22.6, gains of 9.5 and 8.8 points. Under matched low-quality perturbations, average relative degradation is reduced from the strongest non-ours value of 14.6% to 11.1%. On Ego4D-NLQ and QVHighlights, EP-LVMQA remains broadly comparable to established task-specific localization methods.
papers.summary: 长教学视频常被用在医学教育和操作培训里，但证据往往不完整：字幕可能缺失，语音识别嘈杂，画面文字稀疏，关键动作还可能一闪而过、没有旁白。现有视频问答又多只返回标签或自由文本，支撑答案的时间片段不好检查。一种证据保留的由粗到细方法先做不确定感知的多模态证据时间线，再粗规划、细定位，并用一张证据卡片在两级之间传递分数、线索和来源置信。在 MedVidQA 上，按论文采用的交并比门槛，首位召回达到 26.1，比最强外部结果高 6.3 分。在匹配的低质量扰动下，平均相对降幅从 14.6% 降到 11.1%。绝对审核率仍然偏低，还不足以支撑可靠的人对面部署。

papers.title: Beyond Raw Context Transfer: Representation-based Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Can Peng, Yu Liu, YINGYU YANG, Anjie Le, Yuyuan Liu, Qianye Yang, J. Alison Noble
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) by grounding generation in external knowledge. However, most existing RAG frameworks assume a centralized retrieval corpus, which is often impractical in sensitive domains such as healthcare, where data are inherently distributed and raw content cannot be directly shared across institutions. Recent efforts on decentralized RAG primarily follow prompt-based paradigms that exchange raw, human-readable retrieved content, leading to direct exposure of retrieved information and substantial inference-time computational overhead. To address these limitations, we propose Representation-based Federated RAG (FedRepRAG), a decentralized RAG framework that keeps raw documents at their owning clients and exchanges only compact latent representations during cross-client retrieval. To integrate retrieved knowledge, we introduce a collaboratively trained projector that converts retrieval embeddings into generator-compatible representation tokens for a frozen LLM/VLM backbone. Experiments across decentralized visual question answering (VQA) and question answering (QA) benchmarks show that FedRepRAG consistently outperforms direct inference and local retrieval baselines while substantially reducing retrieval-context length and inference-time computational overhead compared with raw-context transfer. Further analyses confirm the importance of query-relevant retrieved representations and characterize the residual representation-level leakage associated with representation exchange. Overall, FedRepRAG provides an effective and efficient framework for federated RAG without transferring raw retrieved content.
papers.summary: 检索增强生成通常假设有一份集中语料，但在医疗这类敏感场景里，原始内容往往不能跨机构直接共享。现有分散式方法又多把检索到的明文段落传来传去，既暴露内容，推理时上下文也很长。一种基于表示的联邦方法让原文留在所属客户端，跨端检索只交换紧凑的潜在表示，再用协同训练的投影器把检索向量转成冻结生成模型能读的表示 token。在去中心化的视觉问答和问答基准上，它持续超过直接推理和仅本地检索；在 SLAKE-EN 更强的异构设定下，准确率比直接推理高出 14.13 个百分点，检索上下文长度相对明文传输缩短约 19 倍到 398 倍。表示交换仍可能留下残留泄露，并不等于端到端保密。

papers.title: How to extract meaning from charts and tables in PDFs
papers.abstract: In this post, we show how late-interaction multi-vector retrieval lets you search PDFs by what the page looks like: no OCR, no chunking, no text extraction.
papers.summary: 把路演材料、年报或论文送进检索增强生成时，传统流程会先抽取文字再切片编码。结果问到营收趋势，常常找回几页无关要点，因为答案其实画在柱状图里，索引根本看不见。延迟交互的多向量模型直接把整页渲染成图再编码，按图像块保留一组向量，查询时对齐页面上真正相关的区域，从而跳过抽取和切片。在 Weaviate Cloud 上用托管模块导入 NVIDIA 最近一个财年的四份季度投资者演示文稿共 92 页，大约一分半就完成，示例问题的头条结果就是能回答该问题的那张图。==图表不该被当成要靠更好的文字识别才能处理的噪声，它本身就是要检索的信息。==纯文本语料仍可能用文本管线更便宜。

papers.title: Weaviate 1.39 Release
papers.abstract: Two search features reach general availability in this release: the Boost API for query-time rescoring, and Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) diversity selection, which works on hybrid search as well as vector search.
papers.summary: 混合搜索的前几条结果，经常是同一段话的多种近重复写法；想把有货或更新的条目往前推，用过滤又会把不满足条件但其实最相关的对象直接丢掉。这次发布把查询时重打分和最大边际相关的多样性选择推进到正式可用：前者按条件重排但不删除对象，后者在相关和多样之间取舍，并且也适用于混合搜索。把有货且较新的商品往前推时，原先排第一的最佳匹配仍然可以留在首位。同期预览的四比特旋转量化，把 1536 维向量压到每个 784 字节，比原始三十二位浮点小 7.84 倍。HNSW 快照也改为自动，用来降低提交日志的磁盘占用并加快启动。
